channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Block Club Chicago To Host Immigration Discussion, Night Of Storytelling In Little Village
item.description: Reporter Francia García Hernández will moderate the free Jan. 20 event at Apollo’s 2000 Theater. It will feature mariachi and spoken word performances, a market and food from local vendors.

item.title: St. Rita’s Father Tom McCarthy Elected Prior Provincial Of Midwest Augustinians
item.description: The Rev. Tom McCarthy, who serves as St. Rita High School’s Director of Community Relations and Shrine Chapel Director, was elected Prior Provincial of the Midwest Augustinians in December.

item.title: Green City Market Finds New Home In North Center For Year-Round Use
item.description: The nonprofit acquired the former garden center on Montrose Avenue in December and plans to start hosting pop-up events there as soon as this spring.

item.title: Fulton Market Could Get A New Public Park Under 30-Story Apartment Project
item.description: The park would be privately managed and located near West Carroll Avenue as part of a proposal to bring 350 new apartments to Racine Avenue.

item.title: Blue-Collar Worker Finds Fame As ‘Cheese Grater Guy’ In Bears’ Iconic Playoff Win Over Packers
item.description: Brandon Martinez went undetected by security on his way to fame for shredding cheese during the Chicago Bears' improbable comeback win Saturday: "Not even a beep," he said.

item.title: Chicago Study: High School Attendance Makes A Big Difference
item.description: In Chicago and across the country, student absenteeism surged during the pandemic. In Chicago Public Schools, the increase has been especially significant and unabated in the high school grades.

item.title: Chicago Public Schools Unveils Calendars For The Coming 2 School Years
item.description: The school board will review the calendars at a meeting this week and is expected to approve them at its regular meeting Jan. 29.

item.title: Missing Bronzeville Teacher Died By Suicide, Officials Confirm
item.description: Linda Brown had been missing since Jan. 3. She's being remembered as a kind neighbor and teacher: "She was definitely a person willing to help.”

item.title: BTS Is Bringing World Tour To Chicago This Summer. Here’s How To Get Tickets
item.description: Tickets go on sale Jan. 22-24 for ARMY Membership holders and the general public.

item.title: Trump Again Threatens To Withhold Federal Funding To Sanctuary Cities Including Chicago
item.description: The pause on billions in federal aid to Chicago would start on Feb. 1, President Donald Trump said Tuesday. Previous efforts to restrict such funding have failed.
